# The Demonic War — Narrative Script

*Audio: 04_The_Demonic_War.mp3 — July 22, 2026*

---

From the perspective of Goldenborn, the dragon king of Baoth.

Baoth was the most advanced city on Ge'or. A surveillance state of unparalleled reach. Every citizen watched. Every conversation recorded. Every dissident disappeared. Goldenborn ruled from the Obsidian Throne with absolute authority — but he was not what he seemed.

The Shadows had been infiltrating Baoth for centuries. They had wormed into the upper echelon of his court. They whispered in his ear. They guided policy. They engineered crises. Goldenborn was never the master of his own kingdom. He was the bait.

The Shadows needed a sacrifice ceremony — an event of such scale that it would fuel their power for millennia. They found it in Kirivis. The Demon King's paranoia, his discovery, his decade of secret study, his forty-five year war — all of it was the ritual. The war itself was the ceremony. Every death fed the Shadows. Every battle advanced their plan.

Kirivis, the genius who saw through everything, was the instrument of their design. His greatest triumph — discovering the truth — was the trap they had laid for him.

At the end, bleeding and near death, Kirivis revealed this to Goldenborn. The sacrifice was complete. The Shadows had what they needed. Goldenborn was no longer necessary.

The dragon king looked at the demon who had destroyed his kingdom. So be it, he said. And he apologized.

Two kings, two enemies, both pawns in a six-thousand-year game. Both dead. The Shadows retreated into hibernation. And the world forgot.
